description.en: Studied practical Python-based analysis, exploratory data analysis, statistical modelling, optimisation, robust data management and reproducible scientific analysis.
description.zh: 学习了基于 Python 的实用数据分析、探索性分析、统计建模、优化、稳健数据管理和可复现科学分析。

description.en: Studied legal, social, ethical and professional responsibilities in computing, including intellectual property, software liability, computer misuse and ethical decision-making.
description.zh: 学习了计算领域的法律、社会、伦理和职业责任，包括知识产权、软件责任、计算机滥用及伦理决策。

description.en: Worked with text corpora, quantitative text analysis, language representation and systems for processing large volumes of natural-language text.
description.zh: 接触文本语料库、量化文本分析、语言表示，以及处理大规模自然语言文本的系统。

description.en: Studied statistical machine learning and probabilistic modelling, with attention to mathematical assumptions and the application of learning algorithms to real-world phenomena.
description.zh: 学习统计机器学习和概率建模，关注数学假设以及学习算法在现实问题中的应用。

title.en: Parallel Computing with Graphical Processing Units (GPUs)
title.zh: Parallel Computing with Graphical Processing Units (GPUs)

description.en: Gained exposure to parallel programming concepts, GPU execution models, performance-aware implementation and the use of accelerators for computational workloads.
description.zh: 接触并行编程概念、GPU 执行模型、性能导向实现，以及加速器在计算任务中的使用。

description.en: Studied parallelisation, stochastic optimisation, Spark, Python/Scala exposure and deployment concepts for high-performance or cluster computing.
description.zh: 学习并行化、随机优化、Spark、Python/Scala，以及高性能或集群计算中的部署概念。

description.en: Studied core NLP concepts, models and algorithms, together with their strengths, limitations and applications.
description.zh: 学习自然语言处理的核心概念、模型和算法，以及它们的优势、限制和应用场景。

description.en: Practised team-based project scoping, requirements analysis, solution design, implementation, presentation and technical reporting.
description.zh: 实践团队项目范围界定、需求分析、方案设计、实现、展示与技术报告。

description.en: Studied discrete and continuous mathematics for computing, including logic, proof, combinatorics, graphs, calculus, matrices and linear algebra.
description.zh: 学习计算机科学所需的离散与连续数学基础，包括逻辑、证明、组合数学、图论、微积分、矩阵和线性代数。

description.en: Developed experience in object-oriented programming with Java, program decomposition, data structures, debugging and maintainable implementation.
description.zh: 通过 Java 学习面向对象编程、程序分解、数据结构、调试与可维护实现。

description.en: Studied foundational ideas in artificial intelligence, intelligent behaviour, search, representation and the relationship between natural and machine intelligence.
description.zh: 学习人工智能基础、智能行为、搜索、知识表示，以及自然智能与机器智能之间的关系。

description.en: Studied how computing devices, operating concepts and networks support communication, computation and end-to-end digital systems.
description.zh: 学习计算设备、操作系统概念与网络如何支撑通信、计算和端到端数字系统。

description.en: Worked with web architecture, client–server interaction, standards-based front-end development and the technologies underlying internet applications.
description.zh: 接触 Web 架构、客户端—服务器交互、基于标准的前端开发，以及互联网应用的基础技术。

title.en: Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures
title.zh: Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures

description.en: Studied algorithmic problem solving, common data structures, correctness, complexity and implementation trade-offs.
description.zh: 学习算法问题求解、常见数据结构、正确性、复杂度和实现取舍。

description.en: Worked in an interdisciplinary team on an engineering challenge, developing problem framing, sustainable design, communication and collaborative decision-making.
description.zh: 在跨学科团队中处理工程挑战，培养问题界定、可持续设计、沟通和协作决策能力。

description.en: Studied finite-state machines, formal languages, pushdown automata, Turing machines, computability and computational complexity.
description.zh: 学习有限状态机、形式语言、下推自动机、图灵机、可计算性与计算复杂度。

description.en: Studied functional programming principles, immutable data, higher-order functions, recursion, type-driven design and reasoning about programs.
description.zh: 学习函数式编程原则、不可变数据、高阶函数、递归、类型驱动设计和程序推理。

description.en: Completed an intensive team exercise centred on employability, project planning, commercial awareness, communication and professional presentation.
description.zh: 完成以就业能力、项目规划、商业意识、沟通和职业展示为核心的密集团队活动。

description.en: Studied sensing, control, perception and decision-making for autonomous systems, with practical attention to how software interacts with physical environments.
description.zh: 学习自主系统中的感知、控制、认知与决策，并关注软件如何与物理环境交互。

description.en: Worked collaboratively to scope, design, implement and communicate an AI-oriented software solution, balancing technical and team requirements.
description.zh: 协作完成 AI 导向软件方案的范围界定、设计、实现和沟通，并平衡技术与团队需求。

description.en: Studied formal logic, automated reasoning, decision procedures, temporal and modal logics, verification and type-system applications.
description.zh: 学习形式逻辑、自动推理、判定过程、时序与模态逻辑、验证和类型系统应用。

description.en: Developed experience in extracting, cleaning, analysing and interpreting data, using computational and statistical methods to answer defined questions.
description.zh: 培养数据提取、清洗、分析和解释经验，使用计算与统计方法回答明确问题。

description.en: Studied secure systems design, threat-aware engineering, access control, defensive thinking and the relationship between architecture and security properties.
description.zh: 学习安全系统设计、威胁导向工程、访问控制、防御性思维，以及架构与安全属性之间的关系。

title.en: Dissertation Project: Emotion Recognition using Visual Information
title.zh: Dissertation Project: Emotion Recognition using Visual Information

description.en: Completed an end-to-end computer-vision project covering literature review, requirements, architecture, model implementation, testing, evaluation, ethics and technical reporting.
description.zh: 完成端到端计算机视觉项目，涵盖文献综述、需求、架构、模型实现、测试、评估、伦理和技术报告。

description.en: Studied mobile application design and implementation, including platform constraints, interface design, lifecycle considerations and device-aware development.
description.zh: 学习移动应用设计与实现，包括平台限制、界面设计、生命周期和设备适配开发。

description.en: Studied computational methods for processing text, including corpus preparation, text representation, analysis pipelines and evaluation.
description.zh: 学习文本处理的计算方法，包括语料准备、文本表示、分析流程和评估。

description.en: Studied computational methods inspired by natural systems, such as evolutionary search, swarm behaviour, neural computation and adaptation.
description.zh: 学习受自然系统启发的计算方法，例如进化搜索、群体行为、神经计算和自适应。

description.en: Gained exposure to financial reasoning, commercial context and legal responsibilities relevant to engineering decisions. The title follows Sheffield’s historical programme regulations.
description.zh: 接触与工程决策相关的财务推理、商业环境和法律责任；课程名称依据谢菲尔德大学历史培养方案。

title.en: Modelling and Simulation of Natural Systems
title.zh: Modelling and Simulation of Natural Systems

description.en: Studied differential-equation and individual-based approaches to dynamic natural systems, including assumptions, limitations, simulation and interpretation.
description.zh: 学习动态自然系统的微分方程与个体建模方法，包括假设、限制、仿真和解释。

description.en: Studied models and reasoning techniques for concurrent and distributed computation, including coordination, communication, correctness and system-level trade-offs.
description.zh: 学习并发与分布式计算的模型和推理方法，包括协调、通信、正确性与系统级取舍。

description.en: Studied adaptive decision-making and reinforcement-learning ideas, including agents, rewards, policies, value estimation, exploration and evaluation. The official historical title is Adaptive Intelligence.
description.zh: 学习自适应决策与强化学习概念，包括智能体、奖励、策略、价值估计、探索与评估；官方历史名称为 Adaptive Intelligence。

description.en: Studied project planning, risk, team organisation, leadership, stakeholder communication and delivery in engineering contexts.
description.zh: 学习工程环境中的项目规划、风险、团队组织、领导力、利益相关者沟通和交付。
